incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: service=inference-embed-queue severity=high PD-INCIDENT=PDR-20260315-01. Trigger: sustained 5xx percentage > 12% across eu-west-1 embed workers. Auto-links: https://pagerduty.example/PD/PDR-20260315-01 

pagerbot: Automatic ack by @maria (primary oncall). Taking ownership for initial triage. :rotating_light:

maria: Acked. I'm going to scope impact first — are customer-facing requests failing or just retries spiking? Can someone grab recent SLO graph?

james: I'm seeing elevated 503s in the logs for embed-worker-2 and embed-worker-5. Error is "kv cache miss overflow" repeatedly. Quick grep: `grep "kv cache miss" /var/log/embed-worker/*.log | tail -n 50` shows repeated TTL eviction on shard-3.

ashwin: Copy. I can rehydrate the cache for shard-3 and bump the cache size to see if that helps. Suggest doing a controlled cache-grow on the two affected hosts first.

maria: Do that. Follow the runbook section "embeds-kv-eviction". Steps: 1) run `kubectl exec -it svc/ops-tool -- /bin/sh` 2) `curl -X POST http://embed-admin/eval/cache/grow?shard=3&percent=25` 3) monitor 503 rate.

james: Running step 2 on embed-worker-2 now. Output: ```{"status":"ok","new_capacity":"+25%","shard":"3"}```

maria: Nice. Monitoring: 503s down from 14% -> 9% in last 3 mins, request latency improving. Keep an eye for ripple on other shards.

pagerbot: Reminder: if still >10% after 10m, pager escalation will attempt second-level paging.

ashwin: After grow, embed-worker-5 still showing bursts. I'm going to rotate traffic off worker-5 (drain) and force a pod restart, then re-evaluate. Doing `kubectl drain` + `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-worker-5` now.

james: Drain started, logs show active connections migrating. Expected short spike during drain.

maria: Good call. I'm posting a quick customer-impact note to #support-alerts: "We are seeing elevated embed errors in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress; potential partial degradation for some customers. Will update in 15m."

ashwin: Pod restarted, health checks passed, traffic gradually shifted back. 503s dropped to 3.2% region-wide. Latency back to normal.

maria: Marking initial incident mitigated, leaving note for follow-up: action items - (1) increase shard-3 cache by 15% permanently, (2) add more aggressive prefetch for cold keys, (3) add runbook checkpoint for auto-grow.

james: Agreed. I'll open a short PR for config change and link the runbook edits.

maria: I'm stepping off in 25m; if anything regresses, please escalate to @james. Handing ownership to james for the next 2 hours while I finish notes. :white_check_mark:

james: Got it — taking over. Will post a postmortem outline to #postmortems once we have full timelines.

pagerbot: Incident PDR-20260315-01 status: acknowledged -> mitigated -> monitoring. Archived automated page in 40m unless reopened.

incident-bot: Closing thread — final summary will be appended to the incident tracker.
